items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication boundaries, least privilege, secret handling, container isolation, release approvals, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, continue bounded read-only security evidence, and permit ordinary reversible growth only when existing consent, disclosures, data handling, claims, and release boundaries are preserved. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.

Security recommendation: retain containment-only execution for security-sensitive work. Continue the existing evidence matrix covering access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency and supply-chain risk, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Keep the gated product private and allow only bounded internal evidence work until material controls are evidenced and owner review is complete.
